name: Freedom

benefits.name: 5% Rotating Bonus Categories
benefits.description: 5% cash back on up to $1,500 in combined purchases in quarterly bonus categories that must be activated each quarter.
benefits.terms: Must activate each quarter. Chase announces one quarterly category list that applies to both this card and Freedom Flex (e.g. Q1 2026: dining, American Heart Association donations, Norwegian Cruise Line). Drops to 1% after the $1,500 quarterly cap. Existing cardholders continue to earn in these categories despite the card being closed to new applicants.

earningRates.terms: 1% on all other eligible purchases. Unlike Freedom Flex, this card has no fixed bonus categories for dining, drugstores, or Chase Travel — those were introduced with Freedom Flex.
